title: 第155章 有因而起第154章 散步
lines: 第155章有因而起
谈文的干练不是白说的，九局这个出力，是真出力，一行人到机场，机场里早就有人等着，领着她们走内部通道进去，停机坪上，谈文租来的一架中型机周围一群比正常多了足有一倍的人手，正忙着检查状态、搬运补给等等。
没多大会儿，接她们进来的年青人，就一路小跑进来，请她们登机。
大家都是累坏了的，上了飞机，各找地方睡觉。
米丽和小火、老常三个到的晚，登机前一刻，才大包小包的匆匆赶到，上了飞机，盛夏先问老常，“找到小龟了？八哥呢？”
“都找到了，逃到咱们刚到滨海时的那个老院子里去了，说是……”老常瞄了眼卫桓，“怕被吃了。”
“那只龟肉老灵气少，不好吃，那只八哥还行，烤一烤还不错。”卫桓紧挨盛夏坐下，接话道。
盛夏斜眼看向卫桓，卫桓立刻笑道：“也一般，好食材多的是。”
正帮着米丽把三个人背上来的大包小包收拾出来的小火，瞥了眼卫桓，捅了捅米丽，嘴角往下扯了扯，米丽斜了她一眼，接着收拾东西。
小夏能辖制得住这位可怕的卫老板，她就放心多了。
盛夏也累了，又问了几句，就蜷在长沙发上睡着了。
半夜落地到欧洲机场，就有人迎上来，带着她们到一辆挂着外交牌照的旅行车旁，卫桓示意周凯，“你去开，不用他们。”
周凯正赞叹周局的卖力，听卫桓这么说，忙上前解释了，从司机手里接过钥匙，坐到驾驶座上。
“这个外交牌照省事是省事了，可也太显眼了。”出了机场，盛夏从后面拍了拍周凯道。
“也是，咱们最好悄无声息的过去，绕几个弯，换辆车？”周凯立刻就明白了盛夏的意思。
“嗯，你安排。”盛夏靠回椅子里。
“这容易。”卫桓看向盛夏，不等他说下去，盛夏挥着手打断了他的话，“知道你的神通，可这不是神通的事，这辆车平白没了，这事就是破绽，你别管，让周凯安排。”
“你说得对。”卫桓绝对的从善如流。
周凯咯的笑了一声，扬声让谈文打电话订了家酒店，车子开进酒店，片刻，各自出来，顺着周凯的指点，从消防通道下到后院，上了辆大街小巷跑的最多的半旧旅行车，绕了几个圈子，又换了两回车，才直奔卡维家族那座庄园。
卫桓让周凯开着车，围着庄园看了半圈，才示意周凯开进去。
车子停在那座著名的城堡前，盛夏示意众人跟在卫桓身边，好奇中提着心，进了城堡。
卫桓抬头看了一圈，示意众人，“没有东西，你们随意。”
“有人吗？”盛夏问了句。
“没有。”卫桓顿了下，“没有活人。”
“大家分头找吧。”盛夏看向谈文和周凯，“曲灵跟谈小姐一起，老常跟周凯，小火跟米丽。”
卫桓一脸笑，他对盛夏这样的分配极其满意。
“等一下，戴上这个。”卫桓叫住谈文，将那枚戒指递给她。
谈文莫名其妙，却毫不迟疑的接过戒指，套在小指上，转身和曲灵一起，往最近的一个房间过去。
“你说没有活人，是什么意思？”看着三组各往一个方向去了，盛夏看向卫桓。
“去看看？”卫桓往城堡后面指了指。
盛夏应了，跟着卫桓，穿过大厅和院子，一直走到城堡最后，卫桓转了个弯，往一间巨大黑石建成的矮小阴沉的建筑过去。
建筑不大，没有窗户，门很宽，卫桓推开门，护着盛夏，无比嫌弃的往旁边错开一步，看向盛夏问道：“黑暗中能看到吗？”
盛夏摇头，她除了死不了抗挨打，别的，就是个凡夫俗子。
卫桓不知道从哪儿摸出个灰扑扑的珠子，递给盛夏，“放口袋里，驱秽用的。”
盛夏接过，卫桓伸出手，“以防万一。”盛夏犹豫了下，将手放到卫桓手里。

Chapter 155 There is a reason
Tan Wen's ability is not for nothing. The Ninth Bureau's efforts are real. When the group arrived at the airport, there were already people waiting at the airport, leading them through the internal passage. On the tarmac, there was a group of people around a medium-sized aircraft that Tan Wen rented, which was twice the normal number. They were busy checking the status, carrying supplies, etc.
Not long after, the young man who picked them up ran in and invited them to board the plane.
Everyone was exhausted, got on the plane, and found a place to sleep.
Mili, Xiaohuo, and Lao Chang arrived late. Just before boarding the plane, they hurriedly arrived with their bags and got on the plane. Shengxia first asked Lao Chang, "Have you found the little turtle? Where is the myna?"
"We found them all and fled to the old courtyard where we first arrived in Binhai. They said..." Lao Chang glanced at Wei Huan, "Afraid of being eaten."
"That turtle's meat is old and lacks energy and is not tasty. That myna's meat is okay. It's not bad when grilled." Wei Huan sat down next to Sheng Xia and continued.
Sheng Xia squinted at Wei Huan, who immediately smiled and said, "It's just average. There are plenty of good ingredients."
Xiao Huo, who was helping Mi Li pack away the large and small bags carried by the three people, glanced at Wei Huan, poked Mi Li, and pulled down the corner of her mouth. Mi Li glanced sideways at her, and then continued to pack her things.
Now that Xiaoxia can control this terrible boss Wei, she feels more relieved.
Shengxia was also tired, so after asking a few more questions, she curled up on the couch and fell asleep.
When they landed at the European airport in the middle of the night, someone greeted them and took them to a station wagon with diplomatic license plates. Wei Huan motioned to Zhou Kai, "You can drive without them."
Zhou Kaizheng was praising Director Zhou for his hard work. After hearing what Wei Huan said, he hurriedly stepped forward to explain, took the key from the driver, and sat in the driver's seat.
"This diplomatic license plate saves trouble, but it is too conspicuous." After leaving the airport, Shengxia patted Zhou Kai from behind and said.
"That's right, we'd better go there quietly, go around a few corners, and change cars?" Zhou Kai immediately understood what Sheng Xia meant.
"Well, you make arrangements." Shengxia leaned back in her chair.
"It's easy." Wei Huan looked at Shengxia. Before he could continue, Shengxia interrupted him with a wave of his hand, "I know your magical power, but this is not a matter of magical power. This car is gone for nothing. This is a flaw. Don't worry about it and let Zhou Kai arrange it."
"You're right." Wei Huan absolutely followed what was good.
Zhou Kai chuckled and asked Tan Wen to call and book a hotel. The car drove into the hotel. After a while, they each came out. Following Zhou Kai's instructions, they went down from the fire escape to the backyard and got into a semi-old station wagon that was most popular on the streets. After going around a few times and changing cars twice, they went straight to the Kawei family's manor.
Wei Huan let Zhou Kai drive the car and looked around the manor for half a circle before motioning for Zhou Kai to drive in.
The car stopped in front of the famous castle. Shengxia motioned for everyone to follow Wei Huan and entered the castle out of curiosity.
Wei Huan raised his head and looked around, signaling to everyone, "There is nothing, you can do whatever you want."
"Is there anyone?" Shengxia asked.
"No." Wei Huan paused, "No one alive."
"Let's look for each other separately." Shengxia looked at Tan Wen and Zhou Kai, "Qu Ling is with Miss Tan, Lao Chang is with Zhou Kai, Xiao Huo is with Mi Li."
Wei Huan smiled. He was extremely satisfied with Shengxia's distribution.
"Wait a minute, put this on." Wei Huan stopped Tan Wen and handed her the ring.
Tan Wen was confused, but he took the ring without hesitation, put it on his little finger, turned around and walked to the nearest room with Qu Ling.
"What do you mean when you say there are no living people?" Seeing the three groups each going in one direction, Shengxia looked at Wei Huan.
"Go and take a look?" Wei Huan pointed towards the back of the castle.
Shengxia agreed and followed Wei Huan through the halls and courtyards until they reached the end of the castle. Wei Huan turned a corner and headed toward a short, gloomy building made of huge black stone.
The building was not big, there were no windows, and the door was very wide. Wei Huan opened the door and protected Sheng Xia. He took a step to the side with disgust, looked at Sheng Xia and asked, "Can you see in the dark?"
Shengxia shook her head. Apart from being unable to resist being beaten, she was just an ordinary person.
Wei Huan took out a dusty bead from nowhere and handed it to Sheng Xia, "Put it in your pocket to drive away dirt."
Shengxia took it and Wei Huan stretched out his hand, "Just in case." Shengxia hesitated and put his hand in Wei Huan's.
